# Chat testimonial — Style Prompt

> Someone else says it for you. A short headline names the subject with one word in handwriting, a sender slides in, a message bubble pops open with three bouncing typing dots, and the words appear letter by letter as if typed live. A reply slides in from the other side, five stars spin into place over a score, and a pill-shaped call to action rises and breathes until the end. Soft, warm and personal: a phone conversation, enlarged and slowed down enough to read.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The film is **one conversation, read in real time**. The viewer watches a message being typed, which makes them wait for it and read it, and the words carry weight because they come from a named person, not from the subject itself. The structure is fixed: who it is about (headline), who is speaking (sender row), what they said (the typed bubble), the answer (a reply), how many agree (stars and a score), what to do (the pill). Everything sits in one column, top to bottom, and nothing leaves the screen once it has arrived: the thread builds up like a real chat.

Not a screen recording of a messaging app (no status bar, no app chrome, no keyboard, no read ticks), not a quote card (the words arrive letter by letter, never all at once), not a slideshow of reviews (one voice, one message, one reply), not a chat-story drama with dozens of bubbles scrolling past (two bubbles at this size, at most three or four short ones).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **The ground**: a 160° linear gradient from the background into the background with 22 % of the main colour, so the bottom of the frame is warmer than the top. Two soft discs float on it: a 300 px disc of the main colour at 25 % bottom left, and a 200 px disc of the accent at 30 % top right, half off the edge. They drift 160 px up and 120 px down over the whole film. No other decoration.
- **Bubbles**: rounded boxes with a 48 px radius, one corner pinched to 12 px on the side of the speaker (top left for the incoming message, top right for the reply), 34 × 44 px padding, at most 820 px wide. They carry a soft, low shadow (0 16 px 40 px, the text colour at 12 %) so they lift off the ground without outlines.
- **Incoming vs reply**: the incoming bubble is the second surface (plain, like paper); the reply is the second surface tinted with 24 % of the main colour and pushed to the right.
- **The avatar**: a 110 px disc in the main colour with the sender's initial; no photo, no illustration.
- **Typing dots**: three 22 px dots in the text colour at 45 %, sitting where the first line of text will appear.
- **Stars**: five plain five-point stars, 104 px, in a fixed star yellow; drawn as inline SVG paths.
- **The pill**: a full-width capsule (130 px tall, 80 px radius) in the main colour with the contact.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar`: the ground at the top; `color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 22%, var(--latar))` at the bottom of the gradient.
- `--latar-2`: the incoming bubble; `color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 24%, var(--latar-2))`: the reply bubble.
- `--utama`: the handwritten name in the headline, the avatar, the call-to-action pill, the large disc.
- `--teks-di-utama`: the avatar's initial and the pill's text.
- `--teks`: the headline, the sender's name, every bubble's text, the score line; its 45 % mix colours the typing dots, its 12 % mix the bubble shadows.
- `--teks-redup`: only the sender's meta line ("pelanggan sejak 2023").
- `--aksen`: only the small disc top right. Keep it quiet.
- Fixed: `--bintang` (#ffb400) for the stars, whatever the brand. A rating is read as yellow; a brand colour on the stars reads as decoration, not as a score.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the headline and the avatar's initial: Poppins 800 by default; any sturdy sans at 800 holds (Archivo Black at about 90 % of the size, a condensed face like Bebas Neue at about 120 %).
- `--font-isi` carries everything else: the bubbles (Poppins 500, sentence case, as people type), the sender row, the score, the pill (800).
- `--font-tangan`, a token of this look, carries the one handwritten word in the headline: Caveat 700. It is the warmth of the style; keep it to the subject's name or two or three words.
- Sizes at 1080 wide: headline 76 px at line-height 1.1, handwritten name 96 px, sender name 48 px, meta 36 px, bubble text 46 px at line-height 1.35, score 50 px, pill 44 px. The meta line at 36 px is the only text under 40 px; it is a label, not a message.
- Write bubble text as people really type: lowercase-friendly, a comma splice, an exclamation mark. One to three sentences, at most about 90 characters per bubble.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Headline**: rises 60 px with a fade over 0.7 s `power3.out`, at 0.2 s.
- **Sender row**: slides in 60 px from the left over 0.5 s `power3.out`, 0.6 s after the headline.
- **Bubble pop**: the incoming bubble scales from 0.6 out of its pinched corner (transform origin top left) with a fade, 0.45 s `back.out(1.8)`.
- **Typing dots**: each dot hops 14 px (0.2 s `sine.inOut`, yoyo, five repeats, so about 1.2 s), staggered 0.1 s, starting 0.2 s after the bubble; they fade out in 0.15 s the moment typing starts.
- **Typing**: every character is its own span and appears in 0.01 s, one every 0.035 s (about 28 characters a second); the 70-letter review takes 2.4 s. Words are wrapped in `nowrap` spans so lines break between words, never inside one. The bubble is already at its final size, so nothing reflows while typing.
- **Reply**: slides in from 120 px to the right with a fade, 0.5 s `back.out(1.6)`, about 1 s after typing ends.
- **Stars**: each pops from scale 0 and −120° rotation over 0.45 s `back.out(2.5)`, staggered 0.14 s (about 1 s for all five); the score line rises 30 px over 0.5 s `power3.out` as the last star lands. Later the stars hop 16 px once, staggered 0.08 s, like a wave.
- **Pill**: rises 200 px with a fade over 0.7 s `expo.out`, then breathes to 1.04 (0.5 s `sine.inOut`, yoyo, three full breaths) and holds still.
- **Background**: the two discs drift on `sine.inOut` over the full 15 s; the whole frame fades out in the last 0.5 s (`power2.in`).
- Things only arrive. Nothing exits until the final fade: the conversation stays readable as a whole.

## 6. Camera grammar

There is no camera move: the frame is a fixed phone-shaped column and the conversation grows down it.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Typing dots in an empty bubble | someone is about to speak; suspense | a review, a viewer's question, a student's message, the first line of a story |
| Letter-by-letter typing | a live, honest voice; makes the viewer read | the testimony itself, a confession, a question that matters |
| Reply sliding in from the other side | an answer, a relationship | the shop's thanks, the creator's answer, the teacher's correction |
| Stars spinning in over a score | many people agree | a rating, a pass rate, "1.200+ ulasan" |
| Pill rising and breathing | the ask | order, follow, join, reply |

## 7. Native moves

- **Typed testimony.** A named sender, typing dots, then the message typed letter by letter. *Fits content like:* a customer praising a home bakery's cake; a viewer telling a cooking channel the recipe worked; a student thanking a tutor before an exam; a text from a mother opening a short story.
- **Reply from the other side.** A short tinted bubble slides in from the right. *Fits content like:* "Terima kasih, Bu Sari!"; a creator answering "Part 2 besok ya!"; a teacher's "Jawabanmu hampir benar"; the reply that turns a story.
- **Star wave.** Five stars spin in one by one over the score, then hop once like a wave. *Fits content like:* "4,9 dari 1.200+ ulasan" for a laundry; "98% murid lulus" for a course; "rating 4,8 di semua episode" for a podcast.
- **Handwritten name.** One word of a sturdy headline in a handwritten face and the main colour. *Fits content like:* "Kata mereka tentang *Kue Rumahan Bunda*"; "Pesan dari *penonton setia*"; "Cerita dari *kelas sore*".
- **Breathing pill.** The contact or ask in a capsule, breathing three times, then still. *Fits content like:* "Pesan di chat 0812-3456-7890"; "Follow untuk cerita berikutnya"; "Daftar kelas gratis".

## 8. Pitfalls

- Typing a long message at 0.035 s per character eats the film: 90 characters is already 3 s. Shorten the message instead of speeding up the typing; below 0.025 s it stops reading as typing.
- Typed text that reflows (letters pushing words to the next line mid-word) looks broken: keep the per-word `nowrap` wrappers and let the bubble reach its final size before typing starts.
- More than three or four bubbles at 46 px push the stars and the pill into the bottom 420 px, where app buttons cover them. Drop a bubble rather than shrinking the type.
- Text on the reply bubble stays `--teks`: the tint is only 24 % of the main colour, so it keeps the second surface's contrast. Raising the tint toward the full main colour needs `--teks-di-utama` instead.
- Stars in the brand colour stop reading as a rating; keep `--bintang`. Only invent a rating or a review count the user gave you.
- A wider brand headline font at 76 px with the 96 px handwritten name wraps to three lines and pushes the chat down: shorten the headline or scale it down.
- No app chrome, no status bar, no read ticks or timestamps: they date the video and imitate a real messaging app.

# Chat testimonial: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.6, medium 2.6, long 3.

## hook

- en: a headline rises, the subject's name in a handwritten face and the main colour
- id: judul naik, nama subjek ditulis tangan dengan warna utama

## problem

- en: the question pops in as an incoming bubble after typing dots
- id: pertanyaan muncul sebagai gelembung masuk setelah titik mengetik

## fact

- en: the answer slides in from the right as a tinted reply bubble
- id: jawaban masuk dari kanan sebagai gelembung balasan berwarna

## step

- en: one short bubble per step, each typed in after the last
- id: satu gelembung pendek per langkah, diketik bergantian

## compare

- en: two replies in a row; the first is struck out and corrected
- id: dua balasan berurutan, yang pertama dicoret lalu dikoreksi

## number

- en: stars pop and spin in one by one, then the score line rises under them
- id: bintang muncul berputar satu per satu, lalu baris skor naik di bawahnya

## proof

- en: a named sender slides in; their review is typed letter by letter after typing dots, then a reply
- id: pengirim bernama masuk, ulasannya diketik huruf demi huruf setelah titik mengetik, lalu dibalas

## offer

- en: the offer arrives as a reply bubble with the price in the main colour
- id: penawaran datang sebagai gelembung balasan, harganya berwarna utama

## cta

- en: a pill in the main colour rises from below and breathes, held 2 s
- id: tombol pil warna utama naik dari bawah lalu bernapas, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the thread stops growing; the last reply holds with the name, 2 s
- id: percakapan berhenti, balasan terakhir diam bersama nama, 2 detik

<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Testimoni chat</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Caveat"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. Bintang dan tulisan tangan milik gaya ini. */
      :root {
        --latar: #fde7ef; --latar-2: #ffffff; --utama: #e0457b; --aksen: #ff7aa8;
        --teks: #2a1720; --teks-redup: #7e6a73; --teks-di-utama: #ffffff;
        --teks-di-aksen: #14161a; --utama-di-latar: #e0457b; --aksen-di-latar: #e0457b;
        --font-judul: "Poppins", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Poppins", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        --bintang: #ffb400; --font-tangan: "Caveat", "Noto Sans", cursive;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; color: var(--teks); font-family: var(--font-isi);
        background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--latar), color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 22%, var(--latar))); }
      .dot { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 25%, transparent); }
      .dot.alt { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--aksen) 30%, transparent); }
      .judul { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; top: 220px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 76px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1; }
      .judul em { font-family: var(--font-tangan); font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; font-size: 96px; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .chat { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; top: 450px; }
      .who { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; margin-bottom: 30px; }
      .ava { width: 110px; height: 110px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama);
        font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; font-size: 54px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
      .who b { display: block; font-size: 48px; }
      .who span { font-size: 36px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      /* Gelembung masuk di permukaan kedua, gelembung keluar diwarnai sedikit warna utama. */
      .bub { position: relative; max-width: 820px; padding: 34px 44px; border-radius: 48px; font-size: 46px; line-height: 1.35;
        background: var(--latar-2); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 12%, transparent); margin-bottom: 30px; }
      .bub.in { border-top-left-radius: 12px; }
      .bub.out { margin-left: auto; border-top-right-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--utama) 24%, var(--latar-2)); }
      .typing { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: flex; gap: 14px; padding: 40px 44px; }
      .typing i { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 45%, transparent); }
      .rating { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; top: 1150px; text-align: center; }
      .stars { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 18px; }
      .stars svg { width: 104px; height: 104px; }
      .stars path { fill: var(--bintang); }
      .rating p { margin-top: 24px; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; }
      .toko { position: absolute; left: 90px; right: 90px; top: 1370px; height: 130px; border-radius: 80px; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama);
        display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 44px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="dot" id="d1" style="width: 300px; height: 300px; left: -80px; top: 1500px"></div>
      <div class="dot alt" id="d2" style="width: 200px; height: 200px; right: -40px; top: 180px"></div>
      <div class="judul" id="judul" data-role="hook">Kata mereka tentang <em>Kue Rumahan Bunda</em></div>
      <div class="chat" id="chat" data-role="proof">
        <div class="who" id="who"><div class="ava">S</div><div><b>Bu Sari</b><span>pelanggan sejak 2023</span></div></div>
        <div class="bub in" id="b1">
          <div class="typing" id="typing"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
          <span id="t1">Kue lapisnya lembut banget, anak-anak sampai rebutan. Minggu depan pesan lagi ya!</span>
        </div>
        <div class="bub out" id="b2">Terima kasih, Bu Sari! Ditunggu pesanannya</div>
      </div>
      <div class="rating" id="rating" data-role="number">
        <div class="stars" id="stars">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2.9 6.6 7.1.6-5.4 4.7 1.6 7L12 17.3 5.8 20.9l1.6-7L2 9.2l7.1-.6z" /></svg>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2.9 6.6 7.1.6-5.4 4.7 1.6 7L12 17.3 5.8 20.9l1.6-7L2 9.2l7.1-.6z" /></svg>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2.9 6.6 7.1.6-5.4 4.7 1.6 7L12 17.3 5.8 20.9l1.6-7L2 9.2l7.1-.6z" /></svg>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2.9 6.6 7.1.6-5.4 4.7 1.6 7L12 17.3 5.8 20.9l1.6-7L2 9.2l7.1-.6z" /></svg>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2.9 6.6 7.1.6-5.4 4.7 1.6 7L12 17.3 5.8 20.9l1.6-7L2 9.2l7.1-.6z" /></svg>
        </div>
        <p id="skor">4,9 dari 1.200+ ulasan</p>
      </div>
      <div class="toko" id="toko" data-role="cta">Pesan di Chat 0812-3456-7890</div>
    </div>
    <script>
      // Pesan diketik huruf demi huruf: setiap huruf jadi span, muncul berurutan di timeline.
      const t1 = document.getElementById("t1");
      // Per kata dibungkus nowrap supaya baris tetap patah di spasi.
      const esc = (c) => (c === "&" ? "&" : c === "<" ? "<" : c);
      t1.innerHTML = t1.textContent.split(" ").map((w) =>
        "<span style='white-space: nowrap'>" + w.split("").map((c) => "<span class='ch'>" + esc(c) + "</span>").join("") + "</span>").join(" ");

      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      tl.fromTo("#d1", { y: 0 }, { y: -160, duration: 15, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 0)
        .fromTo("#d2", { y: 0 }, { y: 120, duration: 15, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 0)
        .from("#judul", { y: 60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: "power3.out" }, 0.2)
        .from("#who", { x: -60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 0.8)
        .from("#b1", { scale: 0.6, opacity: 0, transformOrigin: "0% 0%", duration: 0.45, ease: "back.out(1.8)" }, 1.1)
        // Titik "sedang mengetik" memantul, lalu hilang saat teks muncul.
        .to("#typing i", { y: -14, duration: 0.2, yoyo: true, repeat: 5, ease: "sine.inOut", stagger: 0.1 }, 1.3)
        .to("#typing", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.15 }, 2.6)
        .from(".ch", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.01, stagger: 0.035 }, 2.65)
        .from("#b2", { x: 120, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.6)" }, 6.2)
        // Bintang muncul berputar satu per satu, lalu skor di bawahnya.
        .from("#stars svg", { scale: 0, rotation: -120, duration: 0.45, ease: "back.out(2.5)", stagger: 0.14 }, 7.2)
        .from("#skor", { y: 30, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 8.1)
        // Ajakan naik dari bawah, lalu bernapas sampai akhir.
        .from("#toko", { y: 200, opacity: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: "expo.out" }, 8.6)
        .to("#stars svg", { y: -16, duration: 0.3, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power2.out", stagger: 0.08 }, 10)
        .to("#toko", { scale: 1.04, duration: 0.5, yoyo: true, repeat: 5, ease: "sine.inOut" }, 10.4)
        .to("#root", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, 14.5);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
